title: Vietnamese-Style Coconut Banana Overnight Oats
summary: Creamy vegan overnight oats inspired by Vietnamese coconut desserts, with sweet banana, coconut milk and a hint of cinnamon. Prepare them the night before for a cool, spoonable breakfast.
steps: In a mixing bowl or lidded container, combine the rolled oats, coconut milk, mashed banana, maple syrup, desiccated coconut, chia seeds, vanilla extract, cinnamon and salt.
Stir very well until the banana is evenly mixed through and there are no dry pockets of oats or chia seeds.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours, or overnight, until the oats are soft and the mixture is thick and creamy.
In the morning, stir the oats. If they are thicker than you like, loosen with a small splash of water or extra coconut milk if available.
Spoon into bowls or jars and top with the sliced banana before serving chilled.
